description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI screen called QuizScreen for a quiz application. It manages quiz question display, navigation between questions, and submission logic, including rendering question choices and handling user interactions.

classes.name: QuestionCard
classes.description: A composable function that displays a question and its choices, allowing selection and visual feedback.

methods.name: QuizScreen
methods.description: Main composable function that displays the quiz interface, handles navigation, question rendering, and submission.

methods.name: QuestionCard
methods.description: Displays a single question with choices, allowing user to select an answer.
